verdict.rationale: The docs describe automatic activation from context: Codex starts with each skill's name and description, then loads the full SKILL.md when it decides to use that skill (docs-49). SKILL.md requires a description (docs-13), the skill creator explicitly asks when the skill should trigger (docs-7), and Codex auto-scans .agents/skills from the working directory up to the repo root (docs-17). Community users confirm agents pick up skills when needed and use progressive disclosure (comm-8, comm-5). missing for 10: in-depth first-party guidance on engineering descriptions for accurate triggering, any tooling to test or evaluate activation accuracy, and independent hands-on corroboration that the right skill fires reliably.
